research_question: On the same annotated oracle evidence pages, does rendering a page with a 768-pixel rather than 512-pixel short side improve answer accuracy enough to justify the additional input-token cost?

hypotheses.primary_null: The paired answer-accuracy difference, mean(correct_768 - correct_512), is less than or equal to zero on the frozen matched population.
hypotheses.primary_directional: The paired answer-accuracy difference, mean(correct_768 - correct_512), is greater than zero on the frozen matched population.
hypotheses.engineering_adoption: The 768-pixel condition gains at least 0.05 answer accuracy, its net gain is strictly larger than the observed 512-pixel control correctness-change rate, and its incremental list-price upper-bound cost is at most USD 0.10 per additional correct answer.

primary_outcome.name: paired_answer_accuracy_difference
primary_outcome.definition: mean(correct_768 - correct_512) on the frozen matched population within main_r1

evaluation_metrics.primary: Paired mean of correct_768 - correct_512 in main_r1 on all 37 matched questions.
evaluation_metrics.paired_512_to_768_outcomes: Counts and percentages fixed (512 wrong, 768 correct), broken (512 correct, 768 wrong), both correct, and both wrong; net paired improvement is (fixed - broken) / 37.
evaluation_metrics.control_replicate_variability: On the same 37 questions, report correctness changes, correctness-change percentage, fixed (main_r1 wrong, control_r2 correct), broken (main_r1 correct, control_r2 wrong), and net accuracy difference control_r2 - main_r1.
evaluation_metrics.cost_tradeoff: Incremental 768-minus-512 list-price upper-bound cost divided by the number of additional correct answers; infinity when there is no positive net gain.
evaluation_metrics.descriptive_only: Mean input-token ratio 768/512, benchmark-score difference, document-level effects, clustered bootstrap interval, leave-one-document-out sensitivity, visual-reading subgroup, latency, citations, and false abstention.

held_constant: PNG encoding path except render scale

population.source: answerable questions in the fixed six-document MMLongBench-Doc subset with nonzero annotated evidence pages
population.page_rule: annotated evidence pages only, in benchmark order; no BM25 padding

technical_smoke.purpose: verify request construction, decoded image dimensions and hashes, response parsing, and expected-versus-observed prompt-token accounting; never estimate accuracy
essential_gates: decoded request images match frozen manifest dimensions and SHA-256 hashes
served model equals the requested snapshot
observed prompt tokens are within max(absolute tolerance, relative tolerance times expected tokens)

pilot.purpose: technical feasibility only; selected outcomes must not be used as an estimate of statistical improvement

visual_reading_subgroup.provenance: question IDs assigned the primary manual-review label 'visual reading' before E1 responses are observed
visual_reading_subgroup.interpretation: mechanism-focused and selected, not a population-generalizable subgroup

execution.pairing: Within main_r1, execute the two resolution requests adjacently for each question.
execution.cache_policy: cache entries are namespaced by immutable run ID and replicate ID; a new replicate cannot reuse another replicate's response
record: served model and system fingerprint when returned
live API latency separately from cache lookup latency

decision_rule.status: engineering adoption rule, not a confirmatory significance test

mean_input_token_ratio_768_over_512.role: descriptive only; no threshold because incremental cost per additional correct answer is the computational trade-off criterion

decision_rule.control_variability_measure: The correctness-change rate between main_r1 E1_512 and control_r2 E1_512: (control fixed + control broken) / 37. This is an observed sensitivity margin, not an estimate of a stochastic variance or uncertainty distribution.
decision_rule.run_variability_rule: The main paired 512-to-768 net accuracy gain must be strictly greater than the observed control correctness-change rate. Using all discordant control questions prevents fixed and broken changes from cancelling.
decision_rule.adopt_768: Adopt only when the minimum accuracy-gain, strict control-discordance-margin, and maximum incremental-cost-per-additional-correct criteria all pass.
decision_rule.retain_512: Retain 512 when the primary paired accuracy difference is non-positive.
decision_rule.otherwise: Inconclusive; report the observed trade-off without changing the default.

uncertainty.primary_interval: deterministic percentile bootstrap resampling the six documents as clusters
uncertainty.qualification: With only six document clusters, intervals and McNemar p-values are descriptive and unstable; document-level effects and leave-one-document-out sensitivity must also be shown. Two 512-pixel control replicates do not precisely estimate stochastic uncertainty; their discordance rate is used only as a conservative observed sensitivity margin.
